This building is part of the dwarven [[religion]] system.

It allows a dwarf to join the [[Dwarven Castes#Dwarven Priest|Apostles of Armok]] and construct ceremonial statues and totems that are needed for the [[Altar of Armok]] and [[Temple of Armok]]. It is also possible to Pray To Armok here and train the prayer skill, but without receiving any items as reward.

This building requires an 11x11 space.
